summary: Oscar Piastri won the Miami Grand Prix from P4 on the grid, 4.6s ahead of Lando Norris, with George Russell completing the podium.
Pierre Gasly made the biggest climb, from P20 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 3 virtual safety cars.
The stewards penalised TSU (5 second time penalty).
There were 18 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 16 points over Lando Norris.
